# Real Geometry Dash data fixture (format validation only).
#
# Source: decoded official RobTop level "Stereo Madness" (level id 1), taken
# from the open geometry-dash-web-full port (JeanTheMan/geometry-dash-web-full,
# assets/levels/1.txt): base64url -> gzip -> level string. Only the header and
# a handful of object records are reproduced here to pin the wire format.
#
# What this proves for the GDCode encoder:
#   1. Level string layout: <kS/kA header>;object;object;...;  (';' separated)
#   2. Objects are key,value pairs with keys 1=id 2=x 3=y (+4,5,6,7..13)
#   3. Grid convention: block id 1 at (50,0) -> x=1515 y=15  (g*30+15)
#      spike id 8 at (17,0) -> x=525 y=15
#      half spike id 39 present in official data
#   4. Header keys: kS29..kS37 (legacy color channels), kA13,kA15,kA16,kA14,
#      kA6,kA7,kA2,kA3,kA8,kA4,kA9,kA10,kA11
